scientific.integrity: The motivating preprint and publisher full text were inspected at the model, finite-time-extinction theorem, proof, remark on the fear parameter, and Figure 6. The earlier finite-extinction predecessor was inspected in full. A later related fear/Allee model was inspected through its open full text. A plausible 2026 square-root predator-prey source was available only at abstract level and is retained as a residual risk. The bundled numerical verifier replays the explicit source-data certificate; the finite-time implication is analytic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is a sufficient finite-horizon certificate, not a necessary or sharp extinction threshold. It does not prove the motivating source's full Theorem 5.1 and does not certify the source's plotted k=0.03 example. The comparison regime R_infinity>1 is sufficient only for this proof strategy.

title: A rigorous finite-horizon fear threshold for prey extinction
